competences.description: Smites the enemy, removing all beneficial effects and decreasing its Attack Speed and Attack Power for 3 turns. In addition, increases the damage dealt by 200% if the target is already stunned.
Attacks all enemies to absorb their Attack Bar by 50% and decrease their defense for 3 turns. Guarantees to stun the target if their Attack Bar is depleted.

Whenever attacked, deals damage to the attacker with burning flames and recovers the Boss's HP in proportion to the damage dealt. In addition, increases the Attack Power by 20%, up to 200%, when the Boss gets attacked by the enemy with a Glancing Hit. Resets when the next turn ends. [Automatic Effect]
